verdict.rationale: Slack's own docs say every message, file, and conversation is saved and fully searchable with unlimited message history. Search reaches shared and integrated content, and the official MCP server can also search channels. However, nothing in the evidence documents filtering by sender, channel, or date, or any admin-specific search scope. Missing for 10: documented sender/channel/date search filters, admin-level search across private content, independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
